options.content: ● on target   ● below target   ● well below target   ● data problem  ·  white = no limit set  ·  ⌀ 30-day average  ·  days are midnight to midnight IST  ·  For plant and project managers

panels.description: CBG filled (kg) from the daily statistics table (circleh2o_jabalpurplant_stats). Design capacity 4,800 kg/day. The 30-day average leaves out days below 5 % of design (plant stopped or data outage). Shows the latest day with statistics (normally yesterday; before the morning statistics run, the day before).

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT daily_cbgfilled FROM circleh2o_jabalpurplant_stats WHERE "Date" = (SELECT max("Date") FROM circleh2o_jabalpurplant_stats WHERE "Date" <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) AND daily_cbgfilled IS NOT NULL)) AS "Latest day", (SELECT 100 * daily_cbgfilled / 4800 FROM circleh2o_jabalpurplant_stats WHERE "Date" = (SELECT max("Date") FROM circleh2o_jabalpurplant_stats WHERE "Date" <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) AND daily_cbgfilled IS NOT NULL)) AS "% of design", (SELECT avg(daily_cbgfilled) FROM circleh2o_jabalpurplant_stats WHERE "Date" BETWEEN ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 30) AND ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) AND daily_cbgfilled >= 240) AS "⌀ 30 days"

SELECT to_char(max("Date"), 'DD Mon') || CASE WHEN max("Date") < ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) THEN '|old' ELSE '' END AS "Day" FROM circleh2o_jabalpurplant_stats WHERE "Date" <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) AND "Date" > ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 60) AND daily_cbgfilled IS NOT NULL

panels.title: CBG filled · latest day

panels.description: Raw gas over the last 30 days ÷ feed over the same days (m³ per tonne), matching the 30-day digester retention time. Target = (100 m³/t × pressmud + 40 m³/t × cow manure) ÷ total feed. Days without a gas figure or a feed entry are left out; needs at least 20 days with data. Green at 80 % of target or more, amber 60–80 %, red below 60 %. Shows the latest day with statistics (normally yesterday; before the morning statistics run, the day before).

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (SELECT "Date", daily_rawgas AS g, COALESCE(0,0) AS p, COALESCE(daily_cowmanure,0) AS c FROM circleh2o_jabalpurplant_stats WHERE "Date" >= current_date - 60),
v AS (SELECT "Date", CASE WHEN g IS NOT NULL AND p + c > 0 THEN g END AS g, CASE WHEN g IS NOT NULL AND p + c > 0 THEN p END AS p, CASE WHEN g IS NOT NULL AND p + c > 0 THEN c END AS c, CASE WHEN g IS NOT NULL AND p + c > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ok FROM d),
r AS (SELECT "Date", SUM(g) OVER w AS g30, SUM(p) OVER w AS p30, SUM(c) OVER w AS c30, SUM(ok) OVER w AS n FROM v WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY "Date" RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '29 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW))
SELECT ("Date"::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS time, CASE WHEN n >= 20 THEN g30 / (p30 + c30) END AS "Actual", CASE WHEN n >= 20 THEN (100 * p30 + 40 * c30) / (p30 + c30) END AS "Target", CASE WHEN n >= 20 THEN 100 * g30 / (100 * p30 + 40 * c30) END AS "% of target", n AS "Days with data"
FROM r WHERE "Date" BETWEEN ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 30) AND ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Plant energy ÷ CBG filled (kWh/kg). Days with the plant stopped, and days above twice the 30-day median (implausible), are left out. Shows the latest day with statistics (normally yesterday; before the morning statistics run, the day before).

targets.rawSql: WITH e AS (SELECT "Date", daily_power / NULLIF(daily_cbgfilled, 0) AS se FROM circleh2o_jabalpurplant_stats WHERE "Date" BETWEEN ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 30) AND ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) AND daily_cbgfilled >= 240 AND daily_power > 0), m AS (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY se) AS med FROM e) SELECT (SELECT se FROM e WHERE "Date" = (SELECT max("Date") FROM circleh2o_jabalpurplant_stats WHERE "Date" <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) AND daily_power IS NOT NULL) AND se <= 2 * (SELECT med FROM m)) AS "Latest day", (SELECT avg(se) FROM e WHERE se <= 2 * (SELECT med FROM m)) AS "⌀ 30 days"

SELECT to_char(max("Date"), 'DD Mon') || CASE WHEN max("Date") < ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) THEN '|old' ELSE '' END AS "Day" FROM circleh2o_jabalpurplant_stats WHERE "Date" <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) AND "Date" > ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 60) AND daily_power IS NOT NULL

panels.description: Daily lab results averaged across all digesters and all equalization tanks, so every CBG plant shows the same rows whatever its number of units. VFA / alkalinity is worked out per digester, then averaged. EQ tank pH values above 14 are left out as impossible. No limits are set in the existing Jabalpur dashboards. Latest and days outside are coloured by the limit: green within, amber/red outside, purple impossible value.

targets.rawSql:
WITH x AS (WITH lim(param, test, ord, unit, dec, warn, alarm, lo, hi, sev) AS (VALUES
('Digesters · VFA / alkalinity (average of all)','dig_ratio',1,'',2,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,'amber'),
('Digesters · temperature (average of all)','dig_temp',2,'°C',1,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,'amber'),
('Digesters · TSS (average of all)','dig_tss',3,'mg/L',0,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,'amber'),
('EQ tanks · pH (average of all)','eq_ph',4,'',2,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,'amber'),
('EQ tanks · TSS (average of all)','eq_tss',5,'mg/L',0,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,'amber'),
('Product CH₄','ch4',6,'%',1,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,'red')),
d0 AS (SELECT regexp_replace(lower(btrim(l.location)),':.*$','') AS loc, btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) AS t, (l.time_of_sample_collection AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS day, avg(l.result) AS v FROM user_labtestdata l JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = l.form_id WHERE f.team_id = 6 AND $__timeFilter(l.time_of_sample_collection) AND l.time_of_sample_collection < now() GROUP BY 1, 2, 3),
d AS (SELECT 'dig_ratio' AS test, a.day, avg(a.v / NULLIF(b.v, 0)) AS v FROM d0 a JOIN d0 b ON b.loc = a.loc AND b.day = a.day AND b.t = 'Alkalinity' WHERE a.t = 'Volatile Acids' AND a.loc ~ '^digester [0-9]+$' AND b.v > 0 GROUP BY a.day
 UNION ALL SELECT 'dig_temp', day, avg(v) FROM d0 WHERE loc ~ '^digester [0-9]+$' AND t = 'Temperature' GROUP BY day
 UNION ALL SELECT 'dig_tss', day, avg(v) FROM d0 WHERE loc ~ '^digester [0-9]+$' AND t = 'TSS' GROUP BY day
 UNION ALL SELECT 'eq_ph', day, avg(v) FROM d0 WHERE loc ~ '^equali[sz]ation tank' AND t = 'pH' AND v BETWEEN 0 AND 14 GROUP BY day
 UNION ALL SELECT 'eq_tss', day, avg(v) FROM d0 WHERE loc ~ '^equali[sz]ation tank' AND t = 'TSS' GROUP BY day
 UNION ALL SELECT 'ch4', "Date", daily_avg_ch4_cascade FROM circleh2o_jabalpurplant_stats WHERE "Date" >= ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AND daily_avg_ch4_cascade IS NOT NULL)
SELECT lim.param, lim.ord, lim.unit, lim.dec, lim.warn, lim.alarm, lim.lo, lim.hi, lim.sev, to_char(d.day,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, d.v FROM lim LEFT JOIN d ON d.test = lim.test ORDER BY lim.ord, d.day),
v AS (SELECT param, ord, unit, dec, warn, alarm, lo, hi, sev, NULL::text AS limtxt, day, v, (v < 0 OR (param ~* '\mph\M' AND v > 14)) AS bad FROM x),
p AS (SELECT param, min(ord) AS ord, max(unit) AS unit, max(dec) AS dec, max(warn) AS warn, max(alarm) AS alarm, max(lo) AS lo, max(hi) AS hi, max(sev) AS sev, max(limtxt) AS limtxt,
  avg(v) FILTER (WHERE NOT bad) AS av, min(v) FILTER (WHERE NOT bad) AS mn, max(v) FILTER (WHERE NOT bad) AS mx, count(v) FILTER (WHERE NOT bad) AS n, count(v) FILTER (WHERE bad) AS nbad,
  (array_agg(v ORDER BY day DESC) FILTER (WHERE v IS NOT NULL))[1] AS latest FROM v GROUP BY param),
q AS (SELECT p.*, (SELECT count(*) FROM v WHERE v.param = p.param AND NOT v.bad AND ((p.lo IS NOT NULL AND (v.v < p.lo OR (CASE WHEN p.sev LIKE '%excl' THEN v.v >= p.hi ELSE v.v > p.hi END))) OR (p.lo IS NULL AND p.warn IS NOT NULL AND v.v >= p.warn))) AS nout FROM p)
SELECT param || CASE WHEN unit <> '' THEN ' (' || unit || ')' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN nbad > 0 THEN ' · ' || nbad || ' impossible|purple' ELSE '' END AS "Parameter",
 CASE WHEN latest IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE round(latest::numeric, dec)::text ||
  CASE WHEN latest < 0 OR (param ~* '\mph\M' AND latest > 14) THEN '|purple'
       WHEN lo IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN latest < lo OR (CASE WHEN sev LIKE '%excl' THEN latest >= hi ELSE latest > hi END) THEN '|' || CASE WHEN sev LIKE 'red%' THEN 'red' ELSE 'amber' END ELSE '|ok' END
       WHEN alarm IS NOT NULL AND latest >= alarm THEN '|red' WHEN warn IS NOT NULL AND latest >= warn THEN '|amber' WHEN warn IS NOT NULL THEN '|ok' ELSE '' END END AS "Latest",
 COALESCE(round(av::numeric, dec)::text, '—') AS "⌀ period",
 COALESCE(round(mn::numeric, dec)::text || ' – ' || round(mx::numeric, dec)::text, '—') AS "Range",
 COALESCE(limtxt, CASE WHEN lo IS NOT NULL THEN lo::text || ' – ' || hi::text WHEN warn IS NOT NULL THEN '< ' || warn::text || CASE WHEN alarm IS NOT NULL AND alarm <> warn THEN ' · alarm ' || alarm::text ELSE '' END ELSE '—' END) AS "Limit",
 CASE WHEN (lo IS NULL AND warn IS NULL) OR n = 0 THEN '—' ELSE nout || ' of ' || n || CASE WHEN nout = 0 THEN '|ok' WHEN nout < n / 2.0 THEN '|amber' ELSE '|red' END END AS "Days outside"
FROM q ORDER BY ord

 UNION ALL SELECT 'eq_tss', day, avg(v) FROM d0 WHERE loc ~ '^equali[sz]ation tank' AND t = 'TSS' GROUP BY day
 UNION ALL SELECT 'ch4', "Date", daily_avg_ch4_cascade FROM circleh2o_jabalpurplant_stats WHERE "Date" >= ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AND daily_avg_ch4_cascade IS NOT NULL)
SELECT lim.param, lim.ord, lim.unit, lim.dec, lim.warn, lim.alarm, lim.lo, lim.hi, lim.sev, to_char(d.day,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, d.v FROM lim LEFT JOIN d ON d.test = lim.test ORDER BY lim.ord, d.day) SELECT (day::date)::timestamp AS time, param AS metric, v AS value FROM x WHERE day IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (SELECT "Date", daily_rawgas AS g, COALESCE(0,0) AS p, COALESCE(daily_cowmanure,0) AS c FROM circleh2o_jabalpurplant_stats WHERE "Date" >= ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 30),
v AS (SELECT "Date", CASE WHEN g IS NOT NULL AND p + c > 0 THEN g END AS g, CASE WHEN g IS NOT NULL AND p + c > 0 THEN p END AS p, CASE WHEN g IS NOT NULL AND p + c > 0 THEN c END AS c, CASE WHEN g IS NOT NULL AND p + c > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ok FROM d),
r AS (SELECT "Date", SUM(g) OVER w AS g30, SUM(p) OVER w AS p30, SUM(c) OVER w AS c30, SUM(ok) OVER w AS n FROM v WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY "Date" RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '29 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW))
SELECT to_char("Date",'DD Mon') AS "Day", CASE WHEN n >= 20 THEN g30 / (p30 + c30) END AS "Actual", CASE WHEN n >= 20 THEN (100 * p30 + 40 * c30) / (p30 + c30) END AS "Target", CASE WHEN n >= 20 THEN 100 * g30 / (100 * p30 + 40 * c30) END AS "% of target", n AS "Days with data"
FROM r WHERE "Date" BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AND LEAST(($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date, ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1)) ORDER BY 1
